item.title: Moderna and Merck say their mRNA cancer vaccine cut death, recurrence by 42%
item.description:
📝 The standard treatment was Merck’s established monoclonal antibody cancer treatment Keytruda. What that looked like after two years was that 82 percent of the intismeran-Keytruda treatment group were still alive without recurrence, while only 70 percent of the Keytruda-placebo group were alive without recurrence. 5 percent of the intismeran-Keytruda treatment group were alive without distant metastasis, while 80 percent of the Keytruda-placebo group were alive without distant metastasis.
🔗 Read more: https://arstechnica.com/health/2026/10/personalized-mrna-cancer-vaccine-cut-melanoma-death-recurrence-by-42/
